answer:
# United States refund policy

Customers with a US billing address may request a subscription refund within 7 calendar
days of their first paid subscription purchase. The US refund window is 7 calendar days.
Renewal invoices and usage-based storage overages are not eligible for this refund.

Submit the invoice ID and workspace ID to billing@northwind.example and describe the
reason for the request. Approved refunds return to the original payment method within
10 business days. Cancelling a subscription alone does not submit a refund request.

The workspace remains readable until the end of the paid period unless the owner requests
immediate closure. The EU policy is documented separately and uses a different window. [1]

# API keys

Create an API key from Settings > Developer > API Keys. API keys have a nw_live_ prefix
and are shown only once at creation. Store keys in a secret manager. Never put an API
key in a public repository, browser bundle or support ticket.

API keys expire after 90 days. Rotate a key by creating a replacement, updating clients,
and then revoking the old key. Revocation takes effect immediately. Existing keys cannot
be recovered; create a new key if the secret has been lost.

Each API key is bound to its creating workspace and receives a read or read-write scope.
Send the key using the Authorization: Bearer header. API keys cannot be transferred
between workspaces, and deleting a workspace revokes all of its API keys. [1]
